body.p: You can export an AI conversation to a JSON file using the Export chat... action. The exported file includes useful information, such as details about the invoked action, its parameters, the available tools, the tool calls, the user and assistant messages, and, if applicable, the content on which the action was invoked.
You can import a conversation from a JSON file using the Import chat... action and continue the conversation from that point.

The availability of the actions depends on the product:
In the Oxygen desktop application, the actions are available from the History drop-down menu in the AI Positron view. When the assistant is displayed in a separate window, the history panel appears beside the chat. The actions are available from the menu of the More actions button (the three vertical dots button) at the top of that panel.
In Eclipse, the actions are available in the Actions menu of the AI Positron view.
The actions are not available while the AI is processing a request. Export chat... is available only when the chat displays a conversation.

These actions are particularly useful for debugging. For example, you can export a conversation and share it with the developer of a custom action to help investigate any issues encountered. Once the issue is resolved, you can import the previous conversation and resume where you left off.
